# What are we up against?

.pull-left[
- Deer data
  + NH_deer.txt (.csv)
  
- Shape file
  + New_Hampshire_Political_Boundaries.shp 
  + `sf` object
  
- Land use: 
  + NLCD_2021_Land_Cover_L48_20230630_qtPZ6zMaTAibmibqfd37.tiff 
  + raster -> `stars` object
]


.pull-right[


<img src="https://cdn.britannica.com/40/109040-050-62EEDEA6/Male-white-tailed-deer.jpg" width="450">
]

---

# What are we up against?
.pull-left[
- Create an object named `deer`: 
  + `read_csv()`
  + modify values removing "_"
  + group by `TOWN`
  + summarize with mean of `HSM`
  
- Create an object named `nh`: 
  + `read_sf()`
  + rename the political unit (`pbpNAME`) to match the same in `deer`

- Create an object named `lu`
  + `stars::read_stars()` 
]

.pull-right[

<img src="https://cdn.britannica.com/40/109040-050-62EEDEA6/Male-white-tailed-deer.jpg" width="450">
]



]

---
# What are we up against?

.pull-left[
- Create `nh_dat`: 
  + relative proportion of land use
  + HSM for each town (Hint: `dplyr::group_by(..., .drop = FALSE)` and `dplyr::count()`
  + establishes counts, including 0’s, on a per-Town basis

- Create `rf_dat`:
  + Based on `nh_dat`
  + contains only the data needed to run an RF model 
  + predicts HSM based on land-use proportions. 
  + arcsine transform your proportions data
  + `arc_sin <- function(x) asin(sqrt(x))`
]

.pull-right[

<img src="https://cdn.britannica.com/40/109040-050-62EEDEA6/Male-white-tailed-deer.jpg" width="450">
]


---

# Tuning a RF model



.pull-left[
```{r}
bermuda_house <- st_read("bermuda_shape/bermuda_dat.shp")

rf_dat <- bermuda_house %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  select(-name, -pred_col, -subparish)

head(rf_dat)

```
]

.pull-right[

<img src="https://images.pexels.com/photos/38006677/pexels-photo-38006677.jpeg
" width="400">

]

---

.pull-left[
```{r,fig.height=2}
tuneRF(x=rf_dat %>% dplyr::select(-tot_pop),
       y=rf_dat$tot_pop,
       stepFactor=0.5,
       ntreeTry=1000,
       trace=F,
       mtryStart = 1,
       improve = 0.01,
       )

```
]

.pull-right[

<img src="https://images.pexels.com/photos/38006677/pexels-photo-38006677.jpeg
" width="400">

]
